from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def counts(path, mapq_min=None):
    c=Counter(); n=0; mapped=0; mq=Counter()
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if not line.strip(): continue
            x=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
            mapped+=1
            mq[int(x[11])] += 1
            if mapq_min is not None and int(x[11]) < mapq_min: continue
            gene=x[5].split('|')[5] if '|' in x[5] else x[5]
            c[gene]+=1
    return c,mapped,mq
A,na,mqa=counts('sampleA.paf'); B,nb,mqb=counts('sampleB.paf')
print('mapped',na,nb,'genes',len(set(A)|set(B)))
for cutoff in [0,10,30,100]:
    rows=[]
    for g in set(A)|set(B):
        a,b=A[g],B[g]
        if a+b<cutoff: continue
        # normalize to mapped reads, pseudocount 0.5
        l2=((a+.5)/(na+1))/((b+.5)/(nb+1))
        rows.append((abs(l2),l2,a,b,g))
    print('\\ncutoff',cutoff,'top abs')
    for row in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:40]: print('%8.3f %8.3f %7d %7d %s'%row)
print('\\nMAPQ A',mqa.most_common(10)); print('MAPQ B',mqb.most_common(10))
PY"

from collections import Counter
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, binomtest

def counts(path):
 c=Counter(); n=0
 with open(path) as f:
  for line in f:
   x=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t'); n+=1; c[x[5].split('|')[5]]+=1
 return c,n
A,na=counts('sampleA.paf'); B,nb=counts('sampleB.paf')
# report normalized difference and Fisher p for genes total >= 10
rows=[]
for g in set(A)|set(B):
 a,b=A[g],B[g]
 if a+b<10: continue
 # ratio expected using mapped totals, difference counts relative to expected B
 d=a-(na/nb)*b
 # exact 2x2
 _,p=fisher_exact([[a,na-a],[b,nb-b]], alternative='two-sided')
 l2=((a+.5)/na)/((b+.5)/nb)
 rows.append((p,-abs(d),d,l2,a,b,g))
print('TOP by fisher p')
for p,_,d,l2,a,b,g in sorted(rows)[:100]: print(f'p={p:.3g} d={d:.1f} l2={l2:.2f} A={a} B={b} {g}')
print('\\nTOP by abs normalized difference')
for p,_,d,l2,a,b,g in sorted(rows,key=lambda x:abs(x[2]),reverse=True)[:100]: print(f'p={p:.3g} d={d:.1f} l2={l2:.2f} A={a} B={b} {g}')
PY"

from collections import Counter
from math import log2

def counts(path):
 c=Counter(); n=0
 with open(path) as f:
  for line in f:
   x=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t'); n+=1; c[x[5].split('|')[5]]+=1
 return c,n
A,na=counts('sampleA.paf'); B,nb=counts('sampleB.paf')
rows=[]
for g in set(A)|set(B):
 a,b=A[g],B[g]
 if a+b<10: continue
 d=a-(na/nb)*b
 l2=log2(((a+.5)/na)/((b+.5)/nb))
 # approximate chi-square 1 df for 2 proportions, statistic
 tot=a+b; expa=tot*na/(na+nb); expb=tot*nb/(na+nb)
 # 2x2 chi-square
 chi=(a-expa)**2/expa+(b-expb)**2/expb+((na-a)-(na+nb-tot)*na/(na+nb))**2/((na+nb-tot)*na/(na+nb))+((nb-b)-(na+nb-tot)*nb/(na+nb))**2/((na+nb-tot)*nb/(na+nb)) if tot<na+nb else 0
 # p approx erfc(sqrt(chi/2))
 from math import erfc,sqrt
 p=erfc(sqrt(chi/2))
 rows.append((p,abs(d),d,l2,a,b,g))
print('mapped',na,nb,'genes',len(set(A)|set(B)),flush=True)
print('TOP by chi p',flush=True)
for p,_,d,l2,a,b,g in sorted(rows)[:100]: print(f'p={p:.3g} d={d:.1f} l2={l2:.2f} A={a} B={b} {g}',flush=True)
print('\\nTOP by abs normalized difference',flush=True)
for p,_,d,l2,a,b,g in sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x[1],reverse=True)[:100]: print(f'p={p:.3g} d={d:.1f} l2={l2:.2f} A={a} B={b} {g}',flush=True)
PY"
